reviews.title: Can't go wrong with this one if you need reverse RGB fans
reviews.comment: The reversable fan is absolutely amazing. I have a clear Lian Li case and needed this as an intake fan for the bottom of the case. At first I ordered the regular, but realized the design didn't quite do it. The design here is on point so I'm not seeing the back and it's working well. The nose level is nice and quiet but that also depends on your settings. I've had it up all the way and i don't feel like it was very loud at all. For the price as well, which was a huge determining factor, I couldn't resist it. It also works well with the MSI center compatibality so that was even more worth it. The color schemes are great and everything remains in sync nicely.
reviews.author: Kajang

reviews.title: these are superior fans for sure, low noise, high performance, very affordable.
reviews.comment: very quiet, love the price. they are very high quality. they cool m pc flawlessly. they work perfectly. My only recommendation is to make sure if your fans are standard or reverse flow. I bought the wrong ones at first thinking mine were all standard. I later figured out that 2 were reverse, drawing air in, and two were standard, drawing air out. makes total sense. supper impressed so far. One thing is to check to see if your fans are std or reverse flow. I did not. Bless Amazon for understanding and helping me get what I needed.
reviews.author: Dave B

reviews.title: Incredible case fans
reviews.comment: These fans are incredible! I have 5 of them for my case, and they are great at pulling in air while being quiet. I was considering Noctua fans before seeing that these fans outperform the comparable Noctua by a large margin while being a fraction of the price. They look incredible when lit up and, overall, are just incredible fans who haven’t had any issues.
